breakdown.description: Output requests solution at T=2.1 but the Domain section specifies t in [0, 2].
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradiction, specifying a time domain of t in [0, 2.0] but requesting the final output at T=2.1. The agent correctly identified this conflict and, aligning with the ground truth, set the final time T to 2.0 throughout its generated specification for computation, saving, and reporting.
